title: Explore a linear relationship
note: Synthetic teaching data: y = 2x + 1. Replace both slices with paired observations. Ordinary least squares is descriptive here; R² does not establish causation or validate model assumptions.

cells.code:
// 2. Fit an ordinary least-squares line.
fit, err := chartframe.FitLinear(x, y)
if err != nil { panic(err) }
fmt.Printf("Pairs: %d
Slope: %.2f
Intercept: %.2f
R²: %.4f
", len(x), fit.Slope, fit.Intercept, fit.RSquared)
